# Markdown composer: Write/Preview, toolbar, suggestions and rendered comment bodies ## What to build The review comment composer on the single-run page becomes a small markdown editor, and saved comments render as markdown. Earlier slices delivered the pieces this builds on: - `src/web/assets/comments.js` has `openComposer(afterRow, {title, onSave, onCancel})` (a big auto-growing textarea, `⌘Enter` / `Esc`, a live-check checkbox) and `mountSelection`. It is served from `GET /assets/*` by both servers (`src/web/assets.ts` `serveAsset`), and `src/web/assets/comments.test.ts` tests its pure functions. - `src/review/human.ts` exports `parseSuggestion(body)`. The servers reject a ```` ```suggestion ```` block on an old-side or line-less comment with 400 `suggestion needs side new`. This slice adds: 1. **`src/web/assets/markdown.js`**: a pure, safe markdown renderer, `renderMarkdown(text, { snippet })` → HTML string. It escapes everything first and only adds whitelisted constructs. 2. **Write / Preview tabs** in the composer. Preview calls `renderMarkdown`. 3. **Toolbar**: - **Suggestion** inserts ```` \n```suggestion\n\n```\n ```` at the cursor. It is disabled, with a tooltip, for old-side, file and general comments. - **B** wraps the selection in `**`, **** wraps it in backticks, and **🔗** inserts `[text](https://)`. - Tab inside a code fence inserts two spaces. 4. **Saved comment bodies**: `commentView` and `previousCard` in `src/web/page.html` render them with `renderMarkdown`, not as plain text. 5. **Suggestion mini-diff**: a suggestion block renders as a small diff. The comment's `snippet` lines are shown as `-` (red) and the suggestion lines as `+` (green), under a "Suggested change" header. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/web/assets/comments.js`: `openComposer`, its options and the selected-rows data it gets from `mountSelection` (`rows`, `anchor`, `snippet`). The Suggestion button needs the new-side text of the selected rows: the `add` and `ctx` rows, without the `+`/`-` prefixes. - `src/web/assets/comments.css`: the composer styles to extend. - `src/web/page.html`: `commentView(c, editable)` (around L527–543), `previousCard(c)` (around L564–589) and `reviewRow`/`place()`, where saved comments are rendered. - `src/review/human.ts`: `parseSuggestion`. Mirror its regex in `markdown.js` so the browser and the server agree on what a suggestion is: `/^```suggestion[ \t]*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)^```[ \t]*$/m`. - `src/web/assets/comments.test.ts`: the test style for browser modules. It imports `./comments.js` directly; `tsconfig.json` has `allowJs: true`, and `eslint.config.js` turns `no-undef` off for `src/web/assets/**/*.js`. ## Patterns to follow **Escape first, then transform**: ```js // @ts-check const esc = (s) => s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[c]); ``` Steps in order: 1. Split out fenced code blocks (```` ``` ````, optional info string). The contents of a block are escaped and emitted as `
`. A `suggestion` info string emits the mini-diff instead (`
…`).
2. Split the remaining text into paragraphs on blank lines. Lines starting with `- ` or `* ` become `
  • `, and `1. ` becomes `
    1. `.
3. Inline, on already-escaped text: `` `code` `` → ``, `**b**` → ``, `_i_`/`*i*` → ``, and `[t](https?://…)` → ``. Only `http:` and `https:` URLs become links; anything else stays literal text.
4. A single newline becomes `
      `.

An unclosed fence renders as escaped text. There is never raw HTML, no images, and no attributes other than `href`/`target`/`rel`/`class`.

**Insert into the page**: the only place that sets `innerHTML` is the `renderMarkdown` output. Everything else stays `textContent`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets/markdown.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `renderMarkdown(text, { snippet } = {})` as above.
  - `parseSuggestion(text)`, with the same behaviour as the server version.
  - `suggestionDiff(snippet, suggestion)` returns `{del: string[], add: string[]}`. Snippet lines that start with `-` are left out, because they are old-side lines, and a leading `+` is stripped.
- **GOTCHA**: inline transforms must not run inside `` spans. Tokenize code spans first.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/comments.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `openComposer`:
  - a tab row Write | Preview. Preview hides the textarea and shows a `div.md` with `renderMarkdown(textarea.value, {snippet})`.
  - the toolbar described above. **Suggestion** needs `opts.suggestionText`, which `reviewRow` passes for new-side selections: the selected add and ctx rows' code joined with `\n`. When it is undefined, the button is disabled with the title `Suggestions need lines on the new side`.
  - tab-in-fence handling
- **IMPLEMENT**: export `insertAt(value, selStart, selEnd, before, after)` → `{value, cursor}`. It is pure and used by the toolbar.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/comments.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `.composer .tabs`, `.composer .tools`
  - `.md` typography: `p`, `ul`, `ol`, `code`, `pre`, `a`
  - `.sugg`: a header row "Suggested change", then `-` lines on `var(--diff-del)` and `+` lines on `var(--diff-add)`, in a monospace font

  Use the diff tokens the page already defines.

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `commentView` and `previousCard` render `c.body` (and each follow-up) through `renderMarkdown(text, {snippet: c.snippet})` into a `div.md`
  - `reviewRow` passes `suggestionText` to `openComposer` for new-side selections
  - Edit (PUT) opens the same composer pre-filled
  - a 400 `suggestion needs side new` from the server shows in the composer's error line
- **VALIDATE**: build, then agent-browser per TESTING.md "Human review".

### CREATE `src/web/assets/markdown.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - paragraphs, lists, inline code, bold and italic, links
  - code fences with and without a language
  - a suggestion fence becomes the `.sugg` HTML with the right `-`/`+` lines
  - an unclosed fence
  - XSS payloads, all rendered inert: ``, ``, `[x](javascript:alert(1))`, `[x](data:text/html,...)`, `">
